label: fed-back "n" early in the copy phase (n was original token 1 or 2)
explanation: Token-and-position feature. It fires only in the copy phase, when the input is the letter n (the model feeding back its own n output) and that n was original token 1 or 2, i.e. the step outputs original token 2 or 3. Activations are strongest when n was original token 1 (recall_idx 2, prev2_tok = <DEL>, 65% of activation mass); the top examples are all like x n ... <DEL> x [n]. It is weaker when n was original token 2. It never fires during the original or delimiter phases, even when n is input there. It is essentially silent on other tokens, and only weak or rare on a fed-back n at later copy positions (recall_idx 1 or 4+). It is mostly off in short sequences (L = 3-4), and those make up most of the false positives of the version without the L condition. Dev: P 0.98, R 0.87, F1 0.92, mass recall 0.98. Missed activations are tiny (1.2% of mass): fed-back n at later recall positions.

issues: The claims hold. On dev, 100% of activity is in the copy phase, in_tok n carries 1.000 of the activation mass (only 16 of 30834 active steps are on other tokens), and recall_idx 2 / 3 hold 0.651 / 0.338 of the mass with similar step counts (15078 / 13154), so 'strongest when n was original token 1' is correct. The test scores reproduce exactly: P 0.982, R 0.875, F1 0.925, mass recall 0.981.

Minor overclaim in 'mostly off when L is 3-4'. For n at recall_idx 2 with L=4, precision is 0.53, so the feature fires about half the time. What actually happens at L=4 is that it is off when n is the last fed-back token (recall_idx 3, L=4: precision 0.0). The L>=5 condition is really standing in for 'n is not the final copy input' (to_go >= 1). Scoring with to_go>=1 in place of L>=5 gives the same result as allowing L>=4 for recall_idx 2.

The missed activations are systematic in where they occur but very weak. They are fed-back n at recall_idx 1 (rate 3-9% depending on L), recall_idx 4 (up to about 17% at L=7-9) and recall_idx 2 at L=4. These misses hold only 1.9% of the test activation mass and are mostly rendered at 0.00-0.15 of the max. This is consistent with 'weak or rare at other copy positions'.
False positives (502 on test) are concentrated at recall_idx 3 with L=5 (precision 0.81 there) and are minor.
